Thanks team — good sync this morning. I captured the outstanding exceptions and the three exec asks we need to close before the QBR packet goes to the board. Please confirm owners and ETA below by EOD today so we can roll to the execs tomorrow.

Summary / asks (from today's cross-func run):
- Exception A (billing latency spike on dedicated tenants): owner: Laura; action: triage root cause & mitigation plan; ETA: 10/09
- Exception B (private deployment telemetry gap): owner: Evelyn; action: confirm retention window & SOC2 evidence; ETA: 10/08
- Exec ask #1 (one-time credit request for Orion pilot): owner: Aditya; action: prepare ask memo + financial impact; ETA: 10/07

Next steps I need today:
- Laura: brief RCA bullets + temporary mitigation for the board (2-3 lines)
- Evelyn: confirm which evidence artifacts from SOC2 map to Orion's ask and attach the index
- Aditya: draft the short exec ask doc and cost delta (I put a starter in the tracker)

Attached: QBR_prep_tracker.xlsx (tracker with row owners), starter exec credit doc.
Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcQBR-prep-plan (QBR outline)

Thanks — Nikhil

Nikhil — thanks for pulling this together. Quick updates below; see inline.

- Exception A (billing latency): preliminary root cause points to a misconfigured autoscale throttle on the Dedicated ingestion pool during peak batch windows. Temporary mitigation: bump burst pool by 10% and enable a short-term routing override for affected accounts.
- ETA: I can provide RCA bullets and mitigation text by COB 10/06; full postmortem by 10/12.

I've attached a one-page summary I can drop into the QBR packet.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference

Nikhil / Laura — short note on Exception B telemetry gap.

Background: the private deployment pack we shipped last quarter defaults to a 30-day retention horizon for detailed telemetry; Orion requested 90 days in the SLA. We do have archived traces and can provide SOC2 artifacts that demonstrate retention controls, but the product config requires a change for retained detailed KPIs.

Plan and owner asks:
- I will compile the SOC2 evidence index (mapping doc + exported artifacts) and attach by 10/08.
- Product change to expose retention config is scoped but not slated for GA until Nov; for QBR I propose a commit window with an interim statement: we will backfill 90-day exports for Orion on request (manual process) while engineering schedules the config work.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_index.pdf (index + pointers).

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Platform Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Looping in Mark from ProcureCo on the credit/terms workflow for reference. Quick status on the exec ask:

- Draft exec memo: attached (exec_credit_request_draft.docx) — proposes a one-time pilot credit equal to 30% of three-month host fees in exchange for extended pilot commitment and joint case study.
- Finance/Legal input needed: revenue impact and precedent approvals. Mark — can you confirm what approvals ProcureCo typically needs for a credit this size?
- ETA: I can finalize the memo and run it through finance by 10/07 if I get sign-off on the framing.

Notes: keeping the ask tight (one-paragraph ask + one-slide impact) is preferred for exec review.
